title: oso95/scroll-world
claim: oso95/scroll-world — A skill that turn any brand into a scrollable 3D world
why_good: A skill that turns any brand into a scrollable 3D world — eye-catching for marketing, but a single skill/effect, not a platform.
value: Could sell as a service to agencies/brands wanting 3D landing experiences; project-based, not recurring.
risk: A skill/effect, easily cloned; 3D brand sites are a boutique niche, not a scalable product.
